generator.candidate_order: sorted by (Z band index, -n_targets, region_id); source counts and identities only, never a metric or an error

notes: EZ-B002-v1 selects its regions from a committed synthetic nuclear chart (tests/fixtures/b002/synthetic_chart_v1.mas20) so the whole benchmark is reproducible from the repository alone; raw AME tables are gitignored. Running the identical protocol on AME2020 means re-selecting regions from that snapshot under a new experiment id, because the eligible point set and therefore the deterministic candidate order differ.
region_manifest_hash_rule: ez-b002-region-manifest-hash-v1: sha256 of canonical JSON of {"hash_rule", "region_policy_id", "regions": [region.to_dict() sorted by (region_type, z_min, z_max, n_min, n_max)]}. Region order in the file and any generator metadata cannot change the digest; a bound, a type, or a membership change always does.
